description: Three illustrative three-season rotations for a Mediterranean rainfed field. Replace with the farmer's actual sequence. Crop ids must exist in crop_catalog.json.

rotations.name: Existing / current rotation
rotations.description: Durum wheat followed by fallow, then durum wheat. Represents a common low-input rainfed baseline in which the fallow period stores water and reduces risk.
rotations.rationale: Baseline for comparison. Fallow can conserve moisture but leaves soil exposed and produces no cash crop.
rotations.notes: Replace this sequence with the farmer's real history if known.

rotations.name: Alternative A — cereal–legume
rotations.description: Durum wheat, chickpea, barley. Adds a nitrogen-fixing food legume and a drought-tolerant cereal while keeping the rotation rainfed.
rotations.rationale: Legume nitrogen and diversification with relatively low water demand.
rotations.notes: Chickpea establishment, market access, and rhizobium availability need local verification.

rotations.name: Alternative B — diversified forage/oilseed
rotations.description: Barley, faba bean, sunflower. Combines a drought-tolerant cereal, a high-nitrogen forage legume, and a summer oilseed.
rotations.rationale: Diversifies income and feed supply and adds a strong legume, but sunflower substantially increases water demand in summer.
rotations.notes: Likely requires irrigation for sunflower; confirm water rights and market demand before considering.
